title: Getting started with dqcheckrGUI
text: app needs know folder holds config/, data/, reports/ directories. two ways set : Option — config_dir argument (recommended) Pass path project’s config/ folder launching. works regardless R session’s working directory, important Windows session directory may match script’s location. title: dqcheckrGUI 0.2.0
text: run_app() gains config_dir argument point app specific project folder regardless R session’s working directory. Passing explicitly recommended launching script ‘Windows’ ‘OneDrive’-synced path, getwd() may match script location. argument sets DQCHECKR_CONFIG_DIR session restores previous value exit. First-run modal: dqcheckr.yml found, app now shows dialog offering scaffold config/, data/, reports/ write default global config. Accepting opens Global Config review dataset added. Declining allows manual setup. replaces previous silent redirect Global Config. File folder pickers now root project folder (deployment_root) first entry, followed user home directory system volumes, correct location reachable without navigating unrelated working directory. Pre-run check Run panel now surfaces malformed-‘YAML’ errors explicitly instead silently showing “✓ Configuration looks good” corrupt config file. Custom-check file validation (wizard step 7) now distinguishes source() runtime errors (e.g. missing package, top-level stop()) missing custom_checks function, shows specific error message. ‘pkgdown’ documentation site added https://mickmioduszewski.github.io/dqcheckrGUI/, deployed automatically via ‘GitHub Actions’ every push main.

title: dqcheckrGUI 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-06-24 Initial release: point--click ‘shiny’ front-end ‘dqcheckr’ drives automated dataset quality checks without writing R code. Configuration wizard setting checks new dataset (identity, files, structure, columns, rules, overrides, custom checks, review/save), run panel launching checks incoming file deliveries viewing generated HTML report, history browser past results drift comparisons snapshots. ‘CSV’ onboarding handles header rows duplicate otherwise invalid column names (e.g. extract repeats PayeeName/Amount): raw-header probe (name_repair = "minimal") recovers names suggest_col_names() proposes valid, unique, editable fixes. save renamed header written col_names plus csv_skip: 1, ‘dqcheckr’ (>= 0.2.2) skips original header row instead reading data; clean files write neither key. Relative snapshot_db / report_output_dir paths config resolved deployment root (parent config directory), background ‘callr’ runs execute wd set , GUI reads writes snapshot database ‘dqcheckr’ CLI . Absolute paths continue work unchanged.
